coverLetter:
Dear Hiring Team,
I am applying for the Framework Developer Senior position at CLA. My background combines software development, systems integration, technical leadership, and client implementation support. At DSTax Technologies, I serve as a technical lead and lead developer for a tax-integration platform while coordinating projects and helping clients move from requirements gathering through go-live. This combination of platform development and practical delivery experience is relevant to CLA’s focus on frameworks that support business needs and efficient development across its environments.

Two examples illustrate the experience I would bring. At DSTax Technologies, I led the transition from Version 1 to Version 2 of the tax-integration platform, broadened support for tax providers and financial platforms, and improved UI/UX. I also optimized asynchronous operations to improve performance and throughput and migrated production workloads from DigitalOcean to AWS. Alongside development, I communicated integration updates and project status, resolved implementation issues, and maintained client guides and knowledge-base articles. That work connects platform evolution with the needs of the people implementing and using it. Earlier, at Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global), I evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that made facility information available to employees and customers. I also initiated web automations that reduced manual database maintenance and designed SharePoint data-input forms to improve accessibility and reduce errors. These efforts required evaluating technology against operational needs and making information easier to use across departments.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to CLA’s Framework Engineering Team. The role’s combination of hands-on development, technology evaluation, and shared platform direction aligns with my experience improving a platform while supporting its implementation. I would appreciate the chance to discuss how that background could support CLA’s development needs. Thank you for considering my application.
Sincerely,
Kyle M. Anderson
reviewNotes: Emphasized platform modernization, asynchronous performance, AWS migration, technical leadership, requirements gathering, and technology evaluation. Retained relevant programming, Git, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD skills. The master does not establish direct core-framework engineering, code review, security or compliance ownership, monitoring, command-line proficiency, Bash/PowerShell, YAML, configuration management, or work-tracking systems such as Azure Boards or GitLab Issues.
